pages.title: QA Playground · Free Playwright Practice Exercises
headings: Learn Playwright by testing a real app

h1: Learn Playwright by testing a real app

markup.description: Free hands-on Playwright exercises with TypeScript: locators, forms, tables, dialogs, iframes, shadow DOM, API testing and network mocking. Each exercise has a brief and a full solution.
Hover, a free Playwright practice exercise. Trigger hover states, hover-only menus and tooltips. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Timers & Clock, a free Playwright practice exercise. Test time-based behaviour instantly, and date-based content on any day. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Content & Attributes, a free Playwright practice exercise. Assert text, values, attributes and element state. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Form Validation, a free Playwright practice exercise. Test validation rules and their boundary values. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Basic Table, a free Playwright practice exercise. Read and locate data in a table. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
JavaScript Dialogs, a free Playwright practice exercise. Handle native alert, confirm and prompt dialogs. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Buttons, a free Playwright practice exercise. Use the three kinds of click and verify the result of each. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Appear & Disappear, a free Playwright practice exercise. Wait for elements to appear and disappear, without a single fixed sleep. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.

iFrame Basics, a free Playwright practice exercise. Enter an iframe, work with the form inside it, and tell the frame element from its document. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Keyboard Actions, a free Playwright practice exercise. Drive an input with the keyboard alone. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
API Playground, a free Playwright practice exercise. Check both what the UI shows and what actually went over the network. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Attributes vs Properties, a free Playwright practice exercise. Tell the HTML attribute apart from the live property, and use data attributes. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Inputs, a free Playwright practice exercise. Fill every input type and verify the values the page reports back. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Changing Text, a free Playwright practice exercise. Assert text that changes over time or is different on every run. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Autocomplete, a free Playwright practice exercise. Type into an autocomplete and pick a suggestion. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.

pages.title: Sortable Table · QA Playground
headings: Click a column header to sort the table

markup.description: Sortable Table, a free Playwright practice exercise. Prove a table is sorted correctly, in both directions. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Modal, a free Playwright practice exercise. Test modal behaviour: focus, closing paths and async states. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.

Do I need a test id on every element? +

markup.description: ARIA Widgets, a free Playwright practice exercise. Locate widgets by their ARIA state, and assert whole structures with aria snapshots. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Checkboxes, a free Playwright practice exercise. Change checkbox states and assert both the inputs and the state summary. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Progress Bar, a free Playwright practice exercise. Wait for a value to reach a threshold, then act at the right moment. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.

Nested & Multiple Frames, a free Playwright practice exercise. Reach a frame inside a frame, choose between identical frames, and find a frame with no title. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Drag & Drop, a free Playwright practice exercise. Drag an element onto a drop target. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
API Testing, a free Playwright practice exercise. Test the practice API directly with the request fixture, without a browser. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
File Upload, a free Playwright practice exercise. Upload files without touching the operating system file dialog. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Table Actions, a free Playwright practice exercise. Edit, delete and add rows using the controls inside them. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
New Window, a free Playwright practice exercise. Work with a popup window opened by the page. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Shadow DOM, a free Playwright practice exercise. Interact with web components through open and closed shadow roots. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Radio Buttons, a free Playwright practice exercise. Select a radio option and verify the group allows only one selection. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Actionability, a free Playwright practice exercise. Understand what Playwright waits for before it clicks, and what force: true hides. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Dropdown, a free Playwright practice exercise. Choose options from native selects and from a custom dropdown. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Flaky Lab, a free Playwright practice exercise. Make tests that pass every time, then prove it by running them many times. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Audit practice page: titles, meta tags, images, links and headings.
File Download, a free Playwright practice exercise. Catch downloads and verify their filename and contents. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Data Grid, a free Playwright practice exercise. Work with a server-backed table: search, paginate and select rows. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
New Tab, a free Playwright practice exercise. Follow a link that opens in a new tab. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
Embedded Widgets, a free Playwright practice exercise. Test embedded widgets the way real apps use them. Includes a step-by-step brief and a TypeScript solution.
